description.value: When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Steal] something, observers (creatures other than the creature you stole from) take a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DCs to detect your theft. Additionally, if you first @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Create a Diversion] using Deception, taking a single @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Palm an Object] or Steal action doesn't end your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Undetected] condition.
